banner.title: zigbee2mqtt
banner.tagline: Bridges the Zigbee network to MQTT through an Ember coordinator on the IoT VLAN. The network identity lives in 1Password.

explainer.title: Coordinator on the IoT VLAN, devices on MQTT

steps.title: Identity
steps.text: ExternalSecret zigbee2mqtt pulls the PAN ID, extended PAN ID and network key from one 1Password item. Those three values define the Zigbee network.
steps.scene: a key cut into a radio antenna

steps.title: Route
steps.text: The init container adds the 10.40.0.0/22 route through net1, so the coordinator at 10.40.2.101 is reachable from the main routing table.
steps.scene: a glowing route line over a network switch

steps.title: Radio
steps.text: zigbee2mqtt talks to the Ember coordinator over TCP port 6638 and publishes every device state to EMQX.
steps.scene: a radio tower sending signal waves to a mesh of small devices

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Topics live under zigbee2mqtt/, with Home Assistant discovery on homeassistant/. Permit join is off, so a new device needs a deliberate switch-on.
steps.scene: message packets flowing along a cyan data path to a dashboard

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the data claim to R2 each day. The claim holds the /data contents.
steps.scene: snapshot cards flowing into a cloud bucket
